card.name: Digits inside numbers and units
card.fires_on: A digit or symbol partway through a number or measurement, often the first digit of a value in parentheses after a dose or ratio. Seen most with radiopharmaceutical doses such as GBq and mCi.

modes.label: Digit in dose conversion
modes.description: The leading digit of a value in mCi or units, placed in parentheses after a GBq or similar dose.

modes.description: Other partial pieces such as the start of a prefix or abbreviation.
